question: Can a separately bounded cross-layer interimage adjacency operator retain constant fields and the complete neutral axis while producing a material, deterministic opponent-edge response that is not available from P5C's independent per-channel correction?

candidate.name: zero-sum-cross-layer-bounded-interimage-adjacency-v1
candidate.matrix_contract: finite symmetric graph-Laplacian; diagonal nonnegative; off-diagonal nonpositive; each row sums to zero

research_basis.source: US4833070A, Interimage effects from development inhibitor releasing couplers
research_basis.use: mechanism precedent for interimage effects, sharpness and colour-purity interactions; not parameter calibration

research_basis.source: US6686136B1, Colour photographic material with interlayer imagewise suppression
research_basis.use: mechanism precedent for cross-layer development suppression; not a stock recipe

research_basis.source: Rajkowski and Nowak, Numerical investigation of sharpness in photographic layers containing DIR compounds
research_basis.use: model precedent connecting DIR/DAR chemistry and spatial response; not measured K-MCFM evidence

negative_controls: impulse support outside the exact Gaussian halo
forbidden_fallbacks: reuse or retune the failed external spektrafilm AD1 spatial-DIR candidate
change P5C or P5D frozen parameters, thresholds or results
fit coupling, bounds or gates after viewing this confirmatory report
call the generic matrix a measured DIR coupler, emulsion, stock or process response
